topologies.name: single serialized integration controller
topologies.recovery_rule: durable queue resumes after three downtime ticks; the interrupted item is replayed
topologies.scheduling: FIFO, one unit verified and promoted per simulation tick

topologies.collision_rule: cohort ownership prevents cross-shard mutation; promotion remains serialized
topologies.name: cohort-sharded verification with serialized promotion
topologies.recovery_rule: only the interrupted shard pauses for three ticks and replays one item
topologies.scheduling: each shard verifies one unit per tick; one compact cohort checkpoint is promoted per tick after verification
topologies.worker_result_surface: one isolated verification shard per Wave A cohort

topologies.collision_rule: each losing compare-and-swap is a measured collision
topologies.name: optimistic peer integration against a shared head
topologies.recovery_rule: after three downtime ticks, every in-flight peer retries
topologies.scheduling: all available peers attempt compare-and-swap each tick; one wins and losers retry
topologies.worker_result_surface: ten peers contend directly on one global mutable head

topologies.collision_rule: content IDs are immutable and duplicate references are idempotent
topologies.name: content-addressed immutable manifests with batched fan-in
topologies.recovery_rule: after three downtime ticks, the interrupted reference batch is replayed without re-running producers
topologies.scheduling: ten manifests stage per tick; the singleton authority appends up to eight verified references per tick
topologies.worker_result_surface: ten peers write immutable content IDs to disjoint branches
